:::{#exm-operator}
#### The derivative as an operator

Let $D$ send each differentiable function $f : \reals \to \reals$
to its derivative function $D f = f'$.
Then $D$ is an operator, because its arguments and its values are functions.
For example, $D$ sends $f(x) = x^2$ to the function $(D f)(x) = 2x$.

:::
